annotation.evidence_span: MAY set the spin bit to any value
annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint could consistently set the spin bit to 0 when disabled.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint could consistently set the spin bit to 1 when disabled.
annotation.justification: The 'MAY' keyword allows for different implementations. The specification does not specify *how* the spin bit can be set, only that it *can* be set to any value. This allows for both interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: The specification does not constrain the value to which the spin bit MAY be set when disabled, leading to two reasonable implementations. While the next clause recommends randomness, the target clause only states MAY, so it is not a constraint.
